class.name: WorldData
class.brief_description: A world of the game's own format, as it is saved.
class.description: The world's [code]world.res[/code]: its name, where it lies, the clock it starts at and the cells its sections are drawn in. The world node ([code]World[/code]) is made of it; a plugin's subclass says more of a world it divides otherwise. Saved by its class name, it names no script.

members.member: The scenario clock the world declares for its start, hours; below 0 for none - the scenery's default.
The projected metres (east, north) the world's origin lies at.
The cells of the streaming grid there are sections of ([WorldSection]).
The world's name: its [code].json[/code]'s and its signalling system's.
